comment: Prompt v4: 'low-poly' removed from the system prompt's catalog description (the intro still names the models as low poly). obj_nolp is the objects-only default under v4, paired against the v3 cell obj_nuance, so the comparison isolates the system-prompt wording. obj_nolp_2img additionally packs the same 8 reference sheets into 2 composite images (2x2 grids, black gutters) instead of 8 separate images; it pairs against obj_nolp. Note the composite is capped at the API's 1568px long edge, so its sheets are rendered at ~0.81 scale (~6.2k vs ~9.1k image tokens) - a resolution difference rides along with the packing change.
